SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To embody strife, discord, and chaos; to catalyze conflict that reveals truth or brings necessary change.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The golden apple of discord, the chaos that precedes transformation.

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Propitiated to prevent strife; acknowledged as necessary force; twin of Ares in battle.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient strife deity; merged with Roman Discordia; modern symbol of chaos theory.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted throwing golden apple of discord, or as dark winged goddess accompanying Ares to battle.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Eris of the golden apple, whose gift of strife began the greatest war.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A figure offering you a golden apple inscribed 'For the Fairest,' knowing it will change everything

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Acknowledged as catalyst for necessary change; shadow work around conflict and competition.
AIPromptSeeds: The goddess whose golden apple of discord started the Trojan War.
Strife personified, whose chaos reveals hidden truths.
NarrativeHooks: The catalyst that starts the conflict
The uninvited guest who changes everything
